title: Aye Jaan Sakina nadaan Sakina
body:
Aye Jaan Sakina nadaan Sakina
Aye shaam ke zindaan ki mehmaan Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekho toh uttho qaid may hai kiska yeh maatam
Bano teri is neend ke qurbaan Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Utthti nazar aati nahin yeh neend hai kaisi
Yeh Khwaab tho karta hai pareshaan Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyon haath yeh kaanou pey ho rakhe huvey bibi
Dukhtey hain abhi takh kaho kya kaan Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh deis naya loug naye hum bhi naye hain
Kis tarah sey ho dafn ka samaan Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar ko karo pyaar lo Akbar ki balaaein
Jab khuld mein tum jaao meri jaan Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh roz ki seli woh tera roz ka rona
Bas aaj sey zindaan hai sunsaan Sakina
